verdict.rationale: Aleph documents user-configured mapping agents. Users train them with natural-language prompts, and they then monitor source data 24/7, sending Slack/Teams alerts for approval. Separately, Aleph claims reporting automation, live sync, and putting routine reporting and close processes on 'autopilot'. The only clearly autonomous background agent is limited to data mapping, and the broader autopilot claims are marketing-level with no detail on how users set them up. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation builder or scheduled agent tasks beyond mappings, documented triggers/schedules for reporting automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
